Home/Our services/Bookkeeping & accounts
Accounting & Tax

Bookkeeping & accounts

Good records. Clearer decisions.

Accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping and accounting services to help you understand your finances and prepare for your obligations.

Enquire about accounting
How we can help

A clear view of your financial position.

We provide reliable bookkeeping and accounting support to businesses of all sizes, ensuring your records are accurate, compliant and ready for reporting.

When to speak to us

When you need to bring records up to date, prepare year-end accounts or establish monthly or quarterly management reporting.

  • Bookkeeping & reconciliations

    Maintain sales, purchase and expense records. Reconcile bank accounts, supplier and customer balances, and general ledgers.

  • Annual financial statements

    Prepare year-end accounts, supporting schedules and adjustments for applicable Irish reporting and filing requirements.

  • Management accounts

    Monthly or quarterly reporting, cash-flow information and financial analysis to help you monitor performance and plan ahead.

  • Accounting systems

    Set up and support the use of suitable cloud accounting software, with training and ongoing assistance.

What to know before you beginAny audit exemption position requires a review of current rules and your circumstances. This service does not imply a statutory audit engagement.

A clear next step

How the engagement works.

  1. 01

    Records and dates

    Agree your reporting dates and the records required.

  2. 02

    Preparation and review

    Prepare and reconcile the information, resolving queries with you.

  3. 03

    Accounts and next steps

    Explain the accounts and agree the next reporting or filing steps.

Your first enquiry

Tell us whether you operate as a sole trader or company, your accounting year-end and the bookkeeping or reporting support required. Name your current accounting system if relevant.

We will agree the scope before work begins and explain how to share any records securely.

accounting-services.faq:
Before you enquire

Your questions, explained.

What is the difference between bookkeeping and accounts?

Bookkeeping covers your day-to-day financial transactions, while accounts bring those records together into financial statements. Both are important, and we can support you with either or both.

Management reporting

Do you work with my existing accounting software?

We review your current system, records and access arrangements before recommending how to work together. If a change is needed, we explain the options and agree the approach first.

Cloud accounting

Can you prepare accounts for a sole trader or a limited company?

Yes. We discuss your business structure, accounting period and applicable reporting requirements, then agree the accounts and supporting work needed.

Income tax & Form 11

How often will I receive management reports?

Monthly or quarterly reporting can be agreed around your business needs, the availability of reliable records and the decisions the reports will support.

Management reporting

Do you provide support for VAT returns?

VAT record reviews, reconciliations and return preparation can form part of an agreed engagement. We confirm your registration position, periods and responsibilities before starting.

VAT services

Can you help set up an accounting system?

We can review your requirements, help set up suitable accounting software and agree opening balances, workflows, access and training.

Cloud accounting

Home/Our services/Business planning & strategy
How we can help

From a business question to a practical plan.

We work with businesses at all stages, from start-ups to growing companies, to develop clear and realistic plans that support their goals and improve decision-making.

When to speak to us

When you are starting a new business, considering expansion, reviewing your current strategy or seeking funding support.

  • Start-up & strategy

    Develop business plans for new and existing businesses with a clear market analysis, goals and financial forecasts. Identify growth opportunities and strategies to achieve them.

  • Financial forecasts and planning

    Prepare realistic profit and cash flow forecasts, budgets and performance monitoring systems. Support applications for finance or investment where required.

  • Process improvement

    Review your operations and identify ways to improve efficiency, reduce costs and strengthen systems to support long-term growth.

A clear next step

How the engagement works.

  1. Your proposition

    Share your business idea, current position and key objectives.

  2. Options and recommendations

    We analyse your market, finances and operations and provide practical options and a tailored plan.

  3. Implementation support

    We help you put the plan into action, with ongoing advice and support as your business grows.

Your first enquiry

Tell us about your business, your current stage and what you want to achieve.

We will agree the scope before work begins and explain how to share any records securely.
business-consultancy.faq:
Before you enquire

Your questions, explained.

What does a business plan typically include?

A business plan normally includes an executive summary, market analysis, marketing strategy, operational plan, financial forecasts and a clear implementation plan. We tailor the content to your specific business and objectives.

Financial consultancy

Can you help with applications for finance or investment?

We help prepare business plans, forecasts and supporting financial information for an application. The lender or investor makes the funding decision; approval is not guaranteed.

Financial consultancy

Do you work with start-ups and existing businesses?

Yes. We support new ventures and established businesses with plans shaped around their current position, resources and objectives.

Company formations

Can you provide ongoing strategic advice?

Ongoing reviews can be agreed to monitor performance, revisit forecasts and support the next business decision. The scope and review frequency are set out in the engagement.

Outsourced CFO

Company Services

Business restructuring

Plan company changes with clear information.

We provide practical financial and corporate support for businesses considering changes to their structure, activities or ownership arrangements.

Discuss a business restructuring

For company owners and directors assessing a proposed structural change and the administration that follows.

When to speak to us

  • Objectives and current structure

    Understand the commercial reasons for change and review the available company and financial information. Identify the questions requiring tax, legal or other specialist input.

  • Options and financial implications

    Prepare the agreed financial information and compare relevant operational scenarios. Coordinate tax questions with the appropriate engagement and advisers before implementation.

  • Corporate administration

    Organise the records, approvals and filing information associated with an agreed plan. Define responsibilities and the reporting arrangements needed after the change.

A clear next step

  1. 01

    Define the change

    Clarify the business objective, current structure and proposed timetable.

  2. 02

    Coordinate the review

    Assemble financial information and identify required tax, legal and specialist advice.

  3. 03

    Support implementation

    Carry out the agreed records and administration work once the plan is approved.

Your first enquiry

Outline the proposed change, the companies involved and its current stage. Do not include confidential ownership documents in the public enquiry.

We will agree the scope before work begins and explain how to share any records securely.

business-restructuring.faq:
Before you enquire

Your questions, explained.

How does restructuring differ from growth planning?

Growth planning focuses on commercial direction and operating capacity. A restructuring can also change company arrangements, ownership or corporate administration, so the financial work needs to be coordinated with appropriate legal and tax advice.

Growth & restructuring

Does this service include insolvency appointments?

No insolvency appointment is offered through this page. If a business is in financial distress, the appropriate legal or insolvency professional must advise on those responsibilities and options; our role is defined by the agreed financial and administration work.

Financial consultancy

Do you assist with group reorganisations?

We can coordinate financial information, company records and relevant tax considerations for an agreed reorganisation, working with legal and other specialist advisers where required.

Mergers & acquisitions

Can you help with share transfers or new shareholders?

We help organise the financial information, approvals and records within the agreed scope. Your solicitor advises on the legal terms and documentation for the transaction.

Company secretarial

What will we need to provide to get started?

Your questions, explained.

What is a chargeable disposal?

A chargeable disposal includes the sale, gift or other transfer of an asset, such as land, shares or business assets. Capital gains tax may be due on the gain, subject to reliefs and exemptions.

Income tax & Form 11

Should I review tax reliefs before completing a proposed disposal?

Yes. Review the transaction and eligibility conditions before committing to a disposal, so that relevant reliefs, records and timing can be considered. No relief is assumed until the facts have been checked.

Financial consultancy

How is the gain calculated?

The calculation generally considers disposal proceeds or the applicable valuation, allowable acquisition and disposal costs, relevant losses and any qualifying relief. The treatment depends on the asset and circumstances.

Income tax & Form 11

What records do I need to provide?

Typical records include acquisition and disposal documents, dates, valuations, improvement costs and details of any relevant losses or prior transactions. We confirm the records needed for your case.

Bookkeeping & accounts

Do you assist with CGT for companies and trusts?

We review asset disposals involving individuals, companies and trusts. Company gains are usually reported through Corporation Tax, with special treatment for development land; we confirm the relevant entity, tax and return.

Is the tax position determined only by where I live now?

Your information

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026

ACCTS & TECHS LIMITED is responsible for the personal information it receives through this website. This notice explains what we collect, why we use it, who helps us process it and how to contact us about your rights.

Contact detailsInformation we collectService providersRetentionYour rights

1. Who we are

ACCTS & TECHS LIMITED, company number 494758. Correspondence address: Unit F13, Maynooth Business Campus, Maynooth, Co. Kildare, W23 Y5N7, Ireland. For enquiries about personal information, email info@acctechs.ie or call 045 254212.

2. Information we collect

When you enquire, we receive your name, email address, telephone number, selected service, message and acknowledgement that you have read this notice. A company name is optional. We also receive correspondence you send directly to us.

Our hosting and abuse-prevention services process technical information such as IP addresses, request times, browser information and security events to operate and protect the website. The form uses an empty-field spam check and request throttling.

Please do not use the public form to send PPS numbers, bank information, Revenue passwords, identity records, medical information, CVs or sensitive tax documents. If records are needed for an engagement, we will explain an appropriate transfer method.

3. Why we use your information

We use enquiry details to respond, understand the support you need and take steps at your request before entering an engagement. Where an enquiry concerns a business or another matter outside a prospective contract, we rely on our legitimate interest in responding to relevant correspondence. We also rely on legitimate interests to protect the website and prevent misuse, taking account of your rights.

If you become a client, we process information to provide the agreed services and meet applicable legal obligations. The engagement explains any additional information and requirements. The website privacy acknowledgement is a confirmation that you have read this notice; it is not consent to marketing.

4. Hosting and form delivery

When online enquiries are enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile is a required security check. Cloudflare processes technical browser and challenge information to distinguish people from automated requests. Our server verifies the challenge before sending an enquiry. We temporarily store keyed hashes of email addresses and security tokens, request counters and expiry times for shared abuse prevention; we do not store enquiry content in that security table. See Cloudflare’s Turnstile Privacy Addendum.

Hostinger has been selected for production website hosting. Hosting setup and the associated processing arrangements are being finalised. Hosting services handle the technical request information needed to deliver and protect the website.

The enquiry form validates submissions and limits repeated requests before sending accepted enquiry details to FormSubmit for email delivery to info@acctechs.ie. FormSubmit receives the contact fields and message necessary to send the enquiry. Our mailbox provider then stores and delivers the email. Authorised company personnel use the enquiry to respond. The website does not maintain a separate customer enquiry database. We do not send enquiry content to analytics or advertising services or sell personal information.

Provider information is available in the Hostinger privacy policy and FormSubmit privacy terms. Providers can process information outside the European Economic Area. Contact us for information about the relevant processing locations and transfer arrangements for your enquiry.

We may disclose information to professional advisers or authorities where necessary for an engagement, to meet a legal obligation or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

Optional Google Map

The About and Contact pages offer an interactive Google Map for our correspondence address. It connects to Google only after you choose “Load Google Map”. Google then receives technical request information, including your IP address and browser details, and can use its own cookies and storage. Read Google’s privacy information before loading it.

You can hide the map to remove the embedded frame. This website does not save your map choice. Hiding the frame does not delete cookies Google has already set; those are managed through your browser and Google settings. You can use the directions link instead, which opens Google Maps as an external website.

5. How long we keep information

Enquiries that do not lead to an engagement are deleted from the company’s active enquiry records within 12 months of the last substantive contact, unless a legal requirement, dispute or ongoing request requires longer retention. Client records are retained under the engagement terms and applicable professional, tax and legal requirements.

Technical security records are kept for the period needed to operate, investigate and protect the service. FormSubmit’s documentation states that it retains form submissions for 30 days in its submission archive. Mailbox and backup systems have their own retention and deletion processes. You can contact us to ask about a particular record.

6. Security and your choices

We restrict access to enquiry information to those who need it and use encrypted connections for website and email-service requests. No internet transmission is completely secure. Send only a brief enquiry through this form and follow the secure-transfer instructions provided for any later records.

The required fields help us respond to your enquiry. You can contact us by telephone or email instead. We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing that have legal or similarly significant effects.

7. Your data protection rights

Depending on the circumstances, you can request access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection or portability of your personal information. Where processing relies on consent, you can withdraw that consent without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

Contact info@acctechs.ie to make a request or raise a concern. You can also complain to the Irish Data Protection Commission.

8. Cookies, external links and updates

No analytics or advertising tracking is included. Read our Cookie Policy for the browser-storage inventory. External websites have their own privacy practices. We update this notice when our services or processing change and show the current date above.
